decisions.reason: The source message's specific RR-01 consistency decision is already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY; the general visual-style refinement adds no further identifier change.
The warning's required refined visual treatment and retained confidentiality message are already fully established by its same-message INTRODUCE.
The same-message dashboard MODIFY already captures the larger score, revised heading, and increased result prominence; the general design approach adds no necessary state change.
The same-message header MODIFY already captures the subtle style, suggested content, space constraint, and internal-page scope.
The client says the footer works well but does not change its clean, consistent presentation or all-page coverage; the observation is already represented as runtime verification.
The same-message MODIFY already captures the concise bullet format, detail placement, and example weaknesses, while the general visual-style refinement adds no further requirement change.
The same-message MODIFY already captures the assessment-date and vehicle-identity presentation refinements without changing the broader field-editability requirement.
Retaining and polishing the report's visual direction does not change the required fonts, icons, design assets, or handoff purpose.
